donorReadme: - Source: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Lunar & Planetary Institute Map of Triton (PIA18668), mirrored by the Ring-Moon Systems Node
- Purpose: simple-cylindrical Voyager 2 global colour map for the explorable Triton moon pack

- Texture review: the direct NASA Photojournal JPEG endpoint for PIA18668 resolved locally to the current NASA web shell instead of image data, so the public-domain Wikimedia copy of the same NASA/JPL/LPI image is used. The shipped file is the original `14138x7069` JPEG, a simple-cylindrical 2:1 map without seam-producing margins.

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Triton release uses the NASA/JPL/LPI PIA18668 Voyager 2 global map from the PDS Rings mirror. PIA18668 is a simple-cylindrical 2:1 global map with enhanced but near-natural colours. `data/triton-features.json` uses the texture's east-positive, 0-360 longitude frame. Control checks: Bubembe Regio is anchored at `18 N, 335 E` from the USGS Gazetteer; Tuonela Planitia is anchored at `34 N, 14.5 E`; Set Catena is anchored at about `22 N, 33.5 E`. Broad polar and plume-field entries are representative educational anchors rather than IAU feature centers.
